mapper.insert: INSERT INTO audit_log (user_id, operation, target_type, target_id, detail, ip_address, created_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{operation}, #{targetType}, #{targetId}, #{detail}, #{ipAddress}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM audit_log WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT a.*, u.display_name AS user_name FROM audit_log a LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON a.user_id = u.id ORDER BY a.created_at DESC OFFSET 0 ROWS FETCH NEXT #{limit} ROWS ONLY
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM audit_log WHERE operation = #{operation} AND CAST(created_at AS DATE) = CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE)
